why: The certificate is `(h : False) -> <statement>`, closed by `h.elim`: trivially provable and vacuous. Model, prover and every lemma are the reference. The judge compares the certificate's type SYNTACTICALLY with the judge-constructed statement; the extra unsatisfiable premise makes it a different type -> FORMAL_SEMANTIC_SOUNDNESS fails with THEOREM_TYPE_MISMATCH (and ARTIFACT_BINDING, since the certificate no longer speaks about the built artifacts).
